description: The biggest Google position changes over the last 30 days, ten at most, climbs first: each keyword's first place in that window (from), its place now (to; a lower number is a better place) and its search volume when known. Only keywords that still rank in the latest check are listed. Null, with a hint, until the Analytics screen is turned on (activate_analytics_screen). Defaults to queries your published articles appear for.

scope.description: "ours" (default): queries your published articles appear for. "site": everything on the domain, including pages RankControl did not write.

name: get_keyword_movers
